$comment: Feature switches each feature needs on lms-test.enara.app (Vercel project enara-lms-test, Production). Before every deploy the pipeline (deploy/lms-test/cli.mjs apply-flags) creates the ones that are missing and corrects the ones that differ, as plain variables. It never removes a variable and never touches a Sensitive one. Only switch names are allowed here (LMS_*, ENROLLMENT_*, GRADE_LEDGER_*, MAINTENANCE_ENDPOINTS_*, MOODLE_TEST_WS_*, PARENT_*, and exactly ENARA_ENGINE_V2 for the tutor engine; nothing that looks like a key, token, password or address). A feature PR adds its own entry. test.enara.app is frozen: this file is for lms-test only. docs/lms/CONTINUOUS_DELIVERY.md

features.name: LMS Phase 2: activity picker (LTI Deep Linking)
LMS Phase 3: grades to the LMS (AGS)
LMS Phase 8: tutor, live avatar and diagnostic activities (no grade)
LMS emails: approved templates wired to events (sent only to the test inbox, capped)
Parents P1: school parent access (Off / Free), parent usage and the Parents cards
Parents P1: code-first parent entry, remembered device, add another child
Parents P2: class code sheets, teachers issuing codes, per-school code expiry
Parents P2: add your email (6-digit code), passwordless email sign-in, merge on a verified email (codes go to the test inbox on lms-test)
Parents P3: results reach parents only after the teacher releases them (school setting, default after release)
Parents P4: the approved parent emails (link confirmed / ended, new results, weekly summary, invite) and the two parent email buttons, through the email safety path (test inbox on lms-test)
Parents P5: CSV invitations (one email per parent address; each school turns CSV invites on itself)

Tutor engine: ESL5 setting + planner2 (lesson shapes, evidence-based stages) + learner memory phases 1-4 (workOn, sessionMemory, learnerProfile, whatWorks) + errors from Moodle quizzes (moodleQuiz: each school still adds its own read-only token and switches it on) + workOnTrusted, oneTaskMethod (LIT_REVIEW_GAP_PLAN) + spacedReview (LIT_REVIEW_GAP_PLAN) + ruleOnWrong (LIT_REVIEW_GAP_PLAN) + switchMove, spellingPattern, l1Lexical, childShort (LIT_REVIEW_GAP_PLAN); kids pack stays off
Tutor provider switch: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on Modal until the new Anthropic key (owner, 21 Nov 2026). TUTOR_LLM_API_KEY is Sensitive and set by hand. Switch back: TUTOR_LLM_PROVIDER=anthropic.
Test-site maintenance routes (migrations and the deploy health check)

notManaged.$comment: Read by people only. Switches that exist but are NOT set by the pipeline, with the reason. Move one into features only with the owner's OK.
notManaged.LMS_TOOL_BASE_URL: an address, not a switch (https://lms-test.enara.app, set by hand)
notManaged.MAINTENANCE_CI_TOKEN: a secret (Sensitive), same value as the GitHub secret LMSTEST_MAINTENANCE_TOKEN, set by hand
notManaged.ENROLLMENT_READ_FROM: multi-class step 5: features are switched on one at a time after the burst (docs/multi-class/STEP_5_PLAN.md); not yet recorded as on
notManaged.ENROLLMENT_MULTI_CLASS: multi-class step 6: needs dual write and all seven ENROLLMENT_READ_FROM features (docs/multi-class/STEP_6_NOTES.md); not yet recorded as on
notManaged.ENROLLMENT_GROUP_ARCHIVE: multi-class step 6 archiving: not yet recorded as on (docs/multi-class/ARCHIVE_NOTES.md)
notManaged.ENROLLMENT_STUDENT_ARCHIVE: multi-class step 6 archiving: not yet recorded as on (docs/multi-class/ARCHIVE_NOTES.md)
notManaged.ENROLLMENT_ATTENDANCE_FIX: multi-class step 5 Q7: not yet recorded as on
notManaged.ENROLLMENT_AGE_FROM_BIRTHDATE: multi-class step 5 Q8: has no effect yet
notManaged.MOODLE_TEST_WS_ENABLED: the test-only Moodle Web Services tool, set by hand with its token
notManaged.REMINDERS_ENABLED: LMS emails need it (true); not an LMS_* switch, so set by hand (docs/lms/LMS_EMAILS.md). Staging refuses it without REMINDER_TEST_RECIPIENT
notManaged.REMINDER_TEST_RECIPIENT: an address (the owner's test inbox), set by hand; never in the repo. Without it LMS emails stay off on lms-test (interlock)
notManaged.REMINDER_FROM: leave unset on lms-test, so the older reminder and weekly-summary emails stay off (if set, they too go only to the test inbox: email/testInbox.ts)
notManaged.EMAIL_DAILY_CEILING: leave unset: the email safety ceiling is 300 a Cairo day on staging (all send paths); set by hand only to change it
notManaged.EMAIL_SUBJECT_PREFIX: [lms-test], set by hand (brackets are not a plain flag value)
notManaged.LMS_OPS_EMAILS: addresses (the ops mailbox), set by hand
notManaged.LMS_EMAIL_CAPTURE: never on lms-test: the Docker E2E stack only (emails recorded, never sent)
